title: OneSteel Limited - proposed acquisition of Smorgon Steel Group Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commences assessment under Merger Review Process Guidelines
ACCC requested further information from OneSteel
Closing date for submissions for the first round of market inquiries
ACCC received further information from OneSteel in response to request of 7 July 2006
ACCC requested further information from OneSteel
ACCC received further information from OneSteel in response to request of 28 July 2006
ACCC released a Statement of Issues in relation to the proposed acquisition
Closing date for submissions in response to the Statement of Issues
Proposed announcement of ACCC findings delayed at request of OneSteel to enable more time for OneSteel to respond to the ACCC's Statement of Issues (please see related media release)
Pause in ACCC process extended until further notice
Request for informal clearance of proposed acquisition withdrawn
